scenarios.name: Hero Section Value Proposition Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the hero section effectively communicates MirDB's value proposition with clear headline, tagline, and CTAs

steps.description: Navigate to the MirDB homepage root URL
steps.context: Fresh browser session with no cache

steps.description: Check that hero section appears above the fold with product name, tagline, and CTAs
Verify 'Get Started' and 'View on GitHub' buttons are present and functional

test_cases.input: Check for product name 'MirDB' in hero section
test_cases.expected: Product name 'MirDB' is prominently displayed in the hero section
Tagline communicates persistent key-value store with Memcached compatibility
Button is visible, clickable, and navigates to getting started section or documentation

test_cases.input: Click 'View on GitHub' secondary CTA button
test_cases.expected: Button opens GitHub repository in new tab

test_cases.input: Measure time to understand value proposition
test_cases.expected: User can understand key differentiator (persistence) within 10 seconds of viewing hero

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the features section showcases key MirDB capabilities with icons and descriptions

steps.description: Scroll down to the features section of the homepage
Check that at least 3-4 feature cards are displayed in a grid layout
Verify each feature card has icon, title, and description

test_cases.input: Count feature cards in features section
test_cases.expected: At least 3 feature cards are displayed
Feature card explaining Memcached protocol compatibility is present with icon and description
Feature card explaining persistent storage via SSTables is present
Feature card explaining LSM Tree architecture is present

test_cases.input: Verify each feature card has visual icon
test_cases.expected: All feature cards have an icon or illustration element
Features display in grid on desktop, stack vertically on mobile

scenarios.name: Quick Start Code Snippet
scenarios.description: Verify the quick-start section displays code examples with copy functionality

steps.description: Scroll to or click navigation to quick-start section
Check that code snippet is visible with syntax highlighting
Click copy button and verify code is copied to clipboard

test_cases.input: Check for code snippet showing Memcached client connection
test_cases.expected: Code snippet demonstrates connecting with a standard Memcached client

test_cases.input: Verify default connection address in code
test_cases.expected: Code snippet shows connection to '0.0.0.0:12333' or equivalent
Code is copied to clipboard with visual feedback confirmation
Code snippet has proper syntax highlighting (keywords, strings, etc. colored)
Clear steps to build and run MirDB server are visible
Default config values (port 12333, directories, sizes) are shown

scenarios.name: Navigation Links and Header
scenarios.description: Verify navigation provides clear access to documentation, GitHub, and getting started

steps.description: Check header for logo and navigation links
Click each navigation link and verify correct destination
Scroll page and verify header remains fixed/sticky

test_cases.expected: MirDB logo is displayed in the header navigation
Documentation link is present in navigation and opens documentation
GitHub link is present and opens MirDB repository
Getting Started link navigates to quick-start section or guide

test_cases.input: Scroll page and check header visibility
test_cases.expected: Header remains fixed/sticky at top of viewport while scrolling
Footer displays license information and additional resource links

scenarios.name: Architecture Section and Diagram
scenarios.description: Verify architecture section displays LSM Tree components with visual diagram

steps.description: Scroll to architecture section of the homepage
Check that LSM Tree architecture diagram is displayed
Verify diagram shows key components: Memtable, Immutable Memtable, SSTables, Compaction

test_cases.expected: Visual diagram illustrating LSM Tree structure is present
Diagram includes labeled Memtable component
Diagram includes labeled Immutable Memtable component
Diagram includes labeled SSTables component
Diagram indicates compaction process between levels
Brief text explanation of data flow from write to disk is present

test_cases.input: Verify diagram has alt text for accessibility
test_cases.expected: Architecture diagram has descriptive alt text for screen readers

scenarios.name: Project Status Display
scenarios.description: Verify project status section shows implemented and planned features

steps.description: Find and navigate to project status information
Check that implemented features are listed with indicators
Check that planned/roadmap features are mentioned

test_cases.input: Check for async networking feature status
test_cases.expected: Tokio-based async networking is listed as implemented
Memtable with skip list is listed as implemented
Minor and major compaction are listed as implemented
Raft consensus is listed as planned/upcoming

test_cases.input: Verify link to GitHub for more details
test_cases.expected: Status section includes link to GitHub for detailed roadmap

scenarios.name: Responsive Design - Mobile
scenarios.description: Verify homepage displays correctly on mobile devices

steps.description: Resize viewport to mobile dimensions (375x667 or similar)
Check that all sections adapt to mobile viewport
Verify navigation works correctly on mobile (hamburger menu if applicable)

test_cases.expected: Page renders without horizontal scroll, content fits viewport
Hero text is readable, CTAs are tappable with adequate touch targets
Feature cards stack vertically on mobile viewports
Code snippet is scrollable horizontally if needed, copy button accessible
Navigation is accessible via hamburger menu or similar mobile pattern
Mobile responsiveness score above 90

scenarios.name: Responsive Design - Tablet
scenarios.description: Verify homepage displays correctly on tablet devices

steps.description: Resize viewport to tablet dimensions (768x1024)
Check that all sections adapt appropriately to tablet size

test_cases.expected: Page renders with appropriate tablet layout
Feature cards display in 2-column grid on tablet
Navigation is fully functional and accessible on tablet
Diagram scales appropriately and remains readable

scenarios.name: Performance and Load Time
scenarios.description: Verify homepage meets performance requirements for load time

steps.description: Start with clean browser cache to test cold load
Record time to first contentful paint and full load
Execute Lighthouse performance audit

test_cases.expected: Initial page load under 3 seconds on standard broadband
Homepage load time under 3 seconds on 3G connection
Lighthouse performance score exceeds 90
Total bundle size under 100KB (excluding images)
Below-fold content and images use lazy loading
Images served in modern formats (WebP) with fallbacks

scenarios.name: Accessibility - Keyboard Navigation
scenarios.description: Verify homepage is fully navigable using keyboard only

steps.description: Focus on page and begin Tab navigation
Tab through all links, buttons, and interactive elements
Check that focus states are clearly visible

test_cases.expected: All navigation links are reachable via Tab key
All CTA buttons are focusable and activatable with Enter/Space
All interactive elements show visible focus indicators
Skip to main content link is available for keyboard users

test_cases.input: Navigate code copy button via keyboard
test_cases.expected: Copy button is keyboard accessible and activatable

scenarios.name: Accessibility - Screen Reader
scenarios.description: Verify homepage content is accessible to screen readers

steps.description: Activate screen reader (VoiceOver, NVDA, or similar)
Use screen reader to navigate through all content
Check heading hierarchy and landmark regions

test_cases.expected: Page has logical heading hierarchy (h1 followed by h2, etc.)
Main content areas have appropriate ARIA landmarks

test_cases.input: Check all images for alt text
test_cases.expected: All images have descriptive alt text
All links have descriptive text (no 'click here')
Code blocks are properly marked up for screen readers

scenarios.name: Accessibility - Color Contrast
scenarios.description: Verify color contrast meets WCAG 2.1 AA standards

steps.description: Use accessibility tool to check contrast ratios
Verify all text meets minimum contrast requirements

test_cases.expected: Normal text has contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1
Large text (headings) has contrast ratio of at least 3:1
Button text has sufficient contrast against button background
Links are distinguishable with sufficient contrast
Page passes WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audit

scenarios.name: Dark Mode Support
scenarios.description: Verify homepage supports dark mode based on system preferences

steps.description: Set operating system to dark mode preference
Navigate to homepage with dark mode preference
Check that dark mode color scheme is applied

test_cases.expected: Page displays in dark mode color scheme
Dark backgrounds with light text are applied

test_cases.input: Check code snippet in dark mode

All text maintains sufficient contrast in dark mode

test_cases.input: Toggle between light and dark mode
test_cases.expected: Page responds to system preference changes dynamically

scenarios.name: External Link Security

scenarios.name: Static Site Requirements

Confirm no server-side code is required
Deploy to GitHub Pages or similar static host

Site functions correctly when served by static file server

Site deploys and functions on GitHub Pages

scenarios.name: Content Accuracy
scenarios.description: Verify homepage content accurately represents current MirDB capabilities

steps.description: Verify homepage content matches project documentation
steps.context: Access to project README and docs

steps.description: Check displayed default values match actual defaults

test_cases.expected: Displayed port (12333) matches actual default in codebase
Displayed work directory (/tmp/mirdb) matches actual default

scenarios.name: User Journey - Developer Evaluation
scenarios.description: Verify complete user journey for a developer evaluating MirDB

steps.description: First-time visitor lands on homepage
steps.context: Fresh session, no prior knowledge of MirDB

steps.description: Read hero section and understand what MirDB offers
Scroll through and review key features
View code example and configuration
Click through to detailed documentation

test_cases.input: Complete evaluation journey in under 5 minutes
test_cases.expected: User can complete full evaluation journey within 5 minutes

test_cases.input: Identify use case fit within 30 seconds
test_cases.expected: Developer can determine if MirDB fits their needs from hero section
Average time on page exceeds 2 minutes (engagement metric)
15%+ of visitors navigate to documentation or GitHub

Verify all external links return valid responses

test_cases.expected: All internal links navigate to correct sections
GitHub link returns 200 response and displays repository
